answer: Resist sybils with a weekly identity-slot auction: only 500 licences are minted each week, so fakes cannot flood in. First, each bidder stakes its bid 60 days, and one funder may win at most two slots. Second, winners spend 30 days on probation in a shared garden, capped at five trades a day, peer-countersigned. Third, resold or duplicated licences are burned, stakes slashed. Forging 10,000 identities needs 20 auctions at $200 a slot: $2,000,000 locked, plus 50,000 countersigned trades. Like a river narrowed to one ford, an opal cut to one facet, scarcity makes forgery slow and dear.
